excludedSources.title: Behind-neck machine shoulder press evidence from Coratella et al.
excludedSources.reason: Reviewed as part of the same direct study but not used as the primary variant assumption because the app entry assumes a front guided shoulder press.

excludedSources.title: Upper trapezius and medial deltoid role claims
excludedSources.reason: The evidence supports involvement, but the local anatomy dataset has no separate upper-trapezius or medial-deltoid visible entry; these were documented in limitations instead of being added as unmapped muscles.

notes: Variant assumption is a seated front machine shoulder press with guided handles and back support. Visible roles follow local anatomy constraints and existing standing_barbell_overhead_press precedent. Medial deltoid is likely important for shoulder pressing but lacks a local anatomy mesh entry, so it was not listed as a visible role. Upper trapezius was also not listed because only the aggregate Trapezius entry exists and the existing shoulder-press precedent avoids mapping upper-trapezius-specific findings to that broad label.
